-- Names come from untrusted requests. Only plain file names
-- inside the notes directory are allowed.
is_safe_name(name: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_safe_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_safe_name("../secret.txt") == False
  if name.char_count() == 0
    return False
  if name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  for c in name.chars()
    if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == ":"
      return False
  True

-- The contents of the named note, or "" when it is missing or unreadable.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre is_safe_name(name)
  ex read_note("no-such-file.txt") == ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else ""
    text

-- True when the named file can be opened for reading inside notes.
-- A missing or unreadable file reads as "", so it counts as not readable.
can_read(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  pre is_safe_name(name)
  ex can_read("no-such-file.txt") == False
  read_note(name).char_count() > 0

-- How many of the names are readable files inside notes.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if is_safe_name(name) == False
      continue
    if can_read(name)
      n += 1
  n
